game_title: Mixed Type Oracle – Charred Forest Race
game_concept: A strategy race set in Mt. Pyre – Charred Forest, a burnt forest at the foot of the mountain: the ash ranger must handle ember hounds while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Mixed Type Oracle: Predict the result or error of mixed-type expressions before ember hounds spring the trap.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Charred Forest: a burnt forest at the foot of the mountain
core_gameplay_loop: In Charred Forest, repeat each round: Predict the result or error of mixed-type expressions before ember hounds spring the trap. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the ash ranger ahead. Then check the predictions value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the smelter by solving code steps involving predictions that move the ash ranger forward.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.2).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the smelter first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 9 (extended tier): Mixed Type Oracle
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Mixed Type Oracle' (Week 2 slot 15), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Charred Forest'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how predictions changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ember hounds in Charred Forest.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.2).
